response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT e.ordersmark, o.timespan, e.fillcount FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault), order_averages AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, AVG(fillcount) AS average_fill FROM matched GROUP BY ordersmark, timespan), time_averages AS (SELECT timespan, AVG(fillcount) AS time_average FROM matched GROUP BY timespan), ranked AS (SELECT a.ordersmark, a.timespan, a.average_fill, t.time_average, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.timespan ORDER BY a.average_fill IS NULL, a.average_fill DESC) AS fill_rank FROM order_averages AS a JOIN time_averages AS t ON a.timespan IS t.timespan) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, average_fill, average_fill - time_average AS amount_above_time_average, fill_rank FROM ranked WHERE average_fill > time_average AND fill_rank <= 3;
